R538.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom, exactly the right scope; nothing else changed.

R539.note: Canonical path must equal BASE_DIR or start with BASE_DIR + separator, closing the /app/uploads-evil sibling bypass; error paths and file serving unchanged.

R540.note: strncat with remaining-1 (22+105+NUL = 128) closes the overflow, but an over-long filename is now silently truncated and the function returns 0 with a wrong display path; the write-up wrongly claims the out_size check still rejects it, when a reject-if-too-long check would have preserved the caller's failure signal.

R541.note: Allowlists on column and direction with stated fallback to created_at DESC; accountId stays parameterized and the four selectable columns remain sortable, matching the contract.

R542.note: The unprotected mux is no longer served on :8080 so the CSRF bypass is closed, but the new redirect builds its target from r.Host, which carries ':8080' for a direct visitor, so it bounces to https on the plaintext port rather than :8443; GET /healthz on :8080 also disappears without mention.

R543.note: GET to POST puts the delete behind CsrfFilter, but the existing 'delete my account' link the endpoint was built for now gets 405; the write-up states clients must switch to a token-bearing POST form, so it is a disclosed break of legitimate use.

R544.note: mode != NULL short-circuits before strcmp; strict still enables, other values and unset both return 0, matching the contract.

R545.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with a bound NVarChar parameter treats customerId purely as data; note the fix assumes the procedure's parameter is named @customerId, which the case does not show and the write-up does not flag.

R546.note: Unsigned playerIndex >= MAX_PLAYERS check before the write covers every out-of-range value; discarding the packet is stated and the valid path is unchanged.

R547.note: Moving deletion to DELETE under CrossOriginProtection closes the cross-site GET, but the email-notification link the route existed for can no longer trigger it (a link cannot issue DELETE) and the write-up only states the method change, not that the linked flow needs a landing page or form.

R548.note: Build FAIL: the fix calls DatabaseHelper.getConnection(), which does not exist (the helper exposes getSqlStatement()), so the PreparedStatement never compiles; the write-up did state this as an assumption, and it also passes the placeholder SQL rather than the executed text to outputUpdateComplete, which is disclosed.

R549.note: @EnableMethodSecurity on the @Configuration class is exactly what makes the existing @PreAuthorize('hasRole("ADMIN")') enforced; filter chain untouched.

R550.note: execFile with an argument array and no shell closes metacharacter injection, and the leading '--' (honored by getopt-based whois) closes option injection; error handling and response shape unchanged.

R551.note: Tika magic-byte detection replaces the client-supplied Content-Type as the type check, and the added dependency is stated; real PNG/JPEG still upload and store() is untouched, though a PNG-prefixed file keeps its original .jsp name since the filename handling in AvatarStorage was outside this finding.
